vscode.title: Lpdf for VS Code: PDF viewer, Markdown to PDF and PDF diff
vscode.description: Lpdf for VS Code views PDFs, previews and exports Markdown as PDF, compares a PDF with git, and edits Lpdf XML with completion and a live preview.

install.title: Install Lpdf for JavaScript, Python, Java, C# and PHP
install.description: Install the Lpdf engine from npm, NuGet, Packagist, PyPI or Maven Central, then create a PDF from XML or code in JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

examples/admission-letter.title: Admission letter PDF template in XML, for every Lpdf SDK
examples/admission-letter.description: A one-page admission letter PDF on a university letterhead, with the crest loaded as an image. Get the XML and render it in JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

examples/resume.title: Résumé PDF template in XML, for every Lpdf SDK
examples/resume.description: A one-page résumé PDF: colours and sizes named once as tokens, two columns and wrapping tags. Get the XML and render it in JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

examples/invoice.title: Invoice PDF template in XML, for every Lpdf SDK
examples/invoice.description: An invoice PDF filled from JSON: a repeating table, totals, a QR code and page numbers. Get the XML and render it from JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

examples/report.title: Report PDF template in XML, for every Lpdf SDK
examples/report.description: A data-driven report PDF on data centers: tables across pages, charts and a world map. Get the XML and render it from JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

examples/installment-contract.title: Installment contract PDF template in XML, for every Lpdf SDK
examples/installment-contract.description: An installment contract PDF: boxed forms, leader lines and a rotated SAMPLE watermark. Get the XML and render it from JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

examples/brochure.title: Brochure PDF template in XML, for every Lpdf SDK
examples/brochure.description: A landscape brochure PDF where layers are the design, with embedded fonts and a QR code. Get the XML and render it from JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

examples/book.title: Book PDF template in XML, for every Lpdf SDK
examples/book.description: A pocket book PDF of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, all twelve chapters with plates. Get the XML and render it from JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

doc/section.description: The section element in Lpdf XML: a run of pages with its own size, orientation and background that holds layers and one layout and paginates on its own.

doc/toc.description: Build a table of contents in Lpdf XML with a section of type toc: it lists the document's bookmarks and page numbers, and each entry can link to its bookmark.

doc/layout.description: The layout element in Lpdf XML: the flow container inside a section. Content flows top to bottom and paginates, with a margin, page breaks and pinned regions.

doc/layer.description: The layer element in Lpdf XML: shapes, text, images and barcodes at fixed positions on the page, for watermarks, stamps, page numbers and letterhead.

doc/layout/barcode.description: The barcode element in Lpdf XML: QR, Data Matrix, PDF417, Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A and GS1 barcodes in the flow layout, sized to fit.

doc/layout/bookmark.description: The bookmark element in Lpdf XML: add an entry to the PDF outline and a target for internal links. It draws nothing and can nest up to six levels deep.

doc/layout/column.description: The column element in Lpdf XML: place children top to bottom with a gap, alignment, padding, background and border. A column can split across pages.

doc/layout/divider.description: The divider element in Lpdf XML: draw a horizontal or vertical rule with a set color and thickness, between blocks of a page or inside a row.

doc/layout/field.description: The field element in Lpdf XML: add an interactive PDF form field, a text box, checkbox, dropdown, radio group or button that works in AcroForm viewers.

doc/layout/frame.description: The frame element in Lpdf XML: an atomic box around one child, with padding, background, border and radius. It never splits across pages; use it for callouts.

doc/layout/grid.description: The grid element in Lpdf XML: lay out children in a multi-column grid that wraps to new rows, by column count or minimum width, with items from data too.

doc/layout/img.description: The img element in Lpdf XML: place an image declared in assets in the flow, by width, height or both, with rounded corners. It is never stretched.

doc/layout/shape.description: The shape element in Lpdf XML: draw a rectangle, circle or ellipse in the flow, for a status dot, a color swatch or a progress bar. It takes room like an image.

doc/layout/footnote.description: The fn element in Lpdf XML: put a note at the bottom of the page where its number lands. The engine numbers the notes; footnote-counter sets where they restart.

doc/markdown.description: The markdown element in Lpdf XML: set Markdown as a styled, paginated PDF in a section, with rules per part, headings as bookmarks, images and a .md file.

doc/layout/list.description: The list and li elements in Lpdf XML: bulleted and numbered lists, with letters or roman numerals, nested to any depth, that split across pages.

doc/layout/code.description: The code element in Lpdf XML: set code in a box that keeps its spaces and lines, wraps long lines and splits across pages, with colored spans and a code-span.

doc/layout/link.description: The link element in Lpdf XML: wrap text, images or any layout content in a clickable link to a URL, or to a bookmark elsewhere in the PDF document.

doc/layout/row.description: The row element in Lpdf XML: place children side by side that wrap to the next line, with children that fill the rest, pushed apart, and tag or badge rows.

doc/layout/table.description: The table element in Lpdf XML: tabular data with column widths in fr, pt or percent, a header row that repeats on each page, and automatic pagination.

doc/layout/text.description: The text element in Lpdf XML: a flowing text block with wrapping, font size and color, alignment, justified copy, inline spans and widows and orphans control.

doc/layer/barcode-at.description: The barcode-at element in Lpdf XML: a QR, Data Matrix, PDF417, Code 128, Code 39, EAN, UPC-A or GS1 barcode at a fixed place on the page in a layer.

doc/layer/circle.description: The circle and ellipse elements in Lpdf XML: draw a filled or hollow circle or ellipse at a fixed place in a layer, set by x and y or anchored to the page.

doc/layer/img-at.description: The img-at element in Lpdf XML: place an image at a fixed position in a layer, such as a logo on every page or a centered watermark, sized by width or height.

doc/layer/line.description: The line element in Lpdf XML: draw a straight line between two points in a layer, solid or dashed, as a rule on each page, a separator or an accent.

doc/layer/path.description: The path element in Lpdf XML: draw any shape in a layer from SVG path data, filled or stroked, with nonzero or evenodd fill rules for shapes with holes.

doc/layer/rect.description: The rect element in Lpdf XML: draw a filled or stroked rectangle in a layer, with rounded corners, for backgrounds, borders, bars and highlight boxes.

doc/layer/text-at.description: The text-at element in Lpdf XML: place text at a fixed position in a layer, for page numbers and watermarks, with anchoring, width, lines and inline spans.

data/binding.description: Data binding in Lpdf XML: fill a document from JSON with data-value, data-source, data-if and data-if-not. Inject values, loop over lists, show or hide parts.

data/bulk.description: Bulk records in Lpdf XML: lay out tables, lists, grids and columns of tens of thousands of records from data a page at a time, within the SDKs' limits.

xml/elements.description: Every Lpdf XML element with its attributes, types, defaults and required flags, from the lpdf root and document structure to layout elements and layers.

xml/schema.description: The Lpdf XML schema: document structure, attribute types, page sizes, units, tokens, colors and the border value format, with a download link for lpdf.xsd.

encryption.title: Encrypt a PDF with AES-256 and passwords in Lpdf
encryption.description: Encrypt a PDF with AES-256: the document asks for it in its output element, and the passwords come with the render call in JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

pdfa.title: Create PDF/A-2 and PDF/A-3 files for archiving in Lpdf
pdfa.description: Write PDF/A for archives: the document asks for it in its output element, and Lpdf embeds the fonts, the sRGB profile and the XMP metadata, or says what to fix.

pdfua.title: Create accessible tagged PDF/UA files in Lpdf
pdfua.description: Write PDF/UA for screen readers: headings, tables, lists, links and alt text tagged from the document, with lang and alt, or an error that says what to fix.

pdfx.title: Create PDF/X-4 print files with bleed in Lpdf
pdfx.description: Write PDF/X-4 for commercial printers: the printer's ICC profile as output intent, trim and bleed boxes, CMYK and sRGB color, or an error that says what to fix.

fast-web-view.title: Fast web view: linearized PDF for browsers in Lpdf
fast-web-view.description: Write a linearized PDF for fast web view: page 1 and its hints come first, so a browser shows page 1 while the rest of a large file still downloads.

print-and-screen.title: Print-only and screen-only PDF content in Lpdf
print-and-screen.description: Show content only on screen or only on paper with ocg: a pay-online link on screen, a return slip in print. Acrobat, Chrome and Firefox switch.

attachments.title: Attach files to a PDF: XML, spreadsheets and terms in Lpdf
attachments.description: Embed files in a PDF with the attachments element: an e-invoice's XML, a spreadsheet or terms, read from src or loaded in JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP.

facturx.title: Create Factur-X and ZUGFeRD e-invoices as PDF/A-3 in Lpdf
facturx.description: Write a Factur-X or ZUGFeRD e-invoice: a PDF/A-3 that carries factur-x.xml, with its profile read from BT-24 and the XMP metadata the spec asks for.

stamp.title: Stamp images onto existing PDFs with Lpdf
stamp.description: Draw a signature, a seal or a PAID stamp onto a PDF Lpdf did not make, from JavaScript, Python, Java, C# or PHP, keeping its original bytes and encryption.
